t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Kina paki mulena mulimu waka, uni bupezi kuli ni kuzibe hape ni ku lapele. Na lumela ka nako ye kuli niya fokola wena ki wena ya mata, na mi shebile we na ufumile. Akuma mulimu usili kwanda ahao, kiwena mutusi mwamanyando aluna, upila katato yahao.
